SwiftUI Hotlympics iOS app: rating, leaderboard, upload, photos, profile. Firebase Auth/Storage and Google Sign-In; backend URL in Constants.swift. Rating/leaderboard unrestricted; upload, photos, profile require completed profile. Services: auth/FirebaseAuthService, data/ImageQueueService, api/RatingService, data/ImagePreloader, api/UploadService, data/UserService. Entry: `App/ios_appApp.swift`. Profile requires gender "male" or "female", DOB (must be 18+), and current ToS (1.0); incomplete profiles show ProfileSetupView.

open ios-app.xcodeproj
xcodebuild -project ios-app.xcodeproj -scheme ios-app -destination 'platform=iOS Simulator,name=iPhone 16 Pro' build
xcodebuild test -project ios-app.xcodeproj -scheme ios-app -destination 'platform=iOS Simulator,name=iPhone 16 Pro'
xcodebuild clean -project ios-app.xcodeproj
After making changes, build the project and fix any warnings or errors. Test on iPhone 16 Pro simulator.
